meta.title: Discord Server Verification | Sefinek
meta.description: Complete the verification to join the Discord server. Confirm you meet Discord's minimum age requirements and pass the security check.
meta.tags: discord, verification, server, age requirements, security check, sefinek

page.heading: Discord Server Verification
page.subtitle: To join this server, you must complete verification. Under the Terms of Service, users must also meet the minimum age requirements. The global minimum is 13 years old, but some countries have different age requirements (e.g., 16+ in Poland). Check the full list of age requirements. Failure to meet the age requirements may result in a ban from this server. Remember to think before sending any message.

form.ageConfirm: I confirm that I am at least {{minimumAge}} years old and meet Discord's minimum age requirements applicable in my country.
form.ageConfirm_country: I confirm that I am at least {{minimumAge}} years old and meet Discord's minimum age requirements applicable in {{countryName}}.
form.terms: By joining this server, you agree to comply with Discord's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines and the laws of Poland. Illegal content (e.g., incitement to violence, hate speech, piracy, etc.) will result in an immediate ban.

js.captchaError: hCaptcha error occurred. Please refresh the page and try again.
js.ageRequired: Please confirm that you meet Discord's minimum age requirements
js.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.
js.meshcoreCta: Thanks for joining! We value your time, so you can finish setting up your profile right away and pick your roles (region and hardware). This creates your MeshCore user card, and if you run a repeater, you can verify yourself as an RPT operator. Your profile will then be visible to others on the website and through the /kontakt command on Discord.

manualReview: Your application requires an additional review by the server administrators. Verification may take between 1 and 3 days. You will be notified of the result in a private message. If you have any questions, contact us at contact@sefinek.net. If you prefer not to wait for the result, you may leave the server.
success: Verification completed successfully in {{seconds}} s! You have been granted full access to the server. You can now return to Discord.
